description: This file is a header file defining utilities and macros for test case management in Zephyr RTOS, including result reporting, timing, and command definitions.

methods.name: TC_RESULT_TO_STR
methods.description: Converts test result codes to their string representations.

methods.name: get_start_time_cyc
methods.description: Records the start time of a test in cycle counts.

methods.name: get_test_duration_ms
methods.description: Calculates the duration of a test in milliseconds.
